purpose: Govern every attachment in the complete Y-Shopping reference directory so image-only model names, external demonstrations and untrusted binaries cannot bypass the semantic coverage denominator.

policy.content_addressing: Every referenced attachment is locked by path, byte count and SHA-256; any byte, name or Markdown-reference change invalidates this review.
policy.ocr_role: macOS Vision accurate OCR over zh-Hans and en-US is review discovery evidence only, never production or CI authority.
policy.visual_authority: A legible business-model identifier in a Y-Shopping architecture diagram is governed even when absent from Markdown text; OCR fragments and external screenshots are explicitly corrected or rejected.
policy.binary_authority: Compiled or archived reference artifacts are never executed, imported or accepted as semantic evidence without source, build provenance, dependency review, license review and reproducible verification.

governed_universe.counting_rule: The visual-only HR source dependency expands the source candidate denominator. Visual-only ADS outputs are separately governed derived targets and do not masquerade as source tables.
